t.etext: Tourism and black pearls are the two pillars. Tahitian black pearls farmed in island lagoons are the biggest export, along with tuna, vanilla and coconut oil. France tested nuclear weapons on its atolls from 1966 to 1996, and French government spending is still a big part of the economy.
